statements.quote: Yes, there will be a volume growth from beginning quarter 4 FY26. And yes, there will be a sequential growth in quarter 4 over what we have seen in quarter 3.
We expect the domestic growth to be back on track from FY27 onwards… we should be on a growth momentum.
So broadly, it will be about INR 500 crore to INR 600 crore [capex plan for FY27].
We continue to maintain our long-term GP margin guidance between 50% to 52%, and we continue to move with that.
We have launched 3 new herbicides, Alcor, Comet, Fixit and 1 insecticide Uranus this year with 2 more expected to be launched by the close of FY26.
We will be coming up with the plans and announcing that [pharma intermediate plant capex] in the next quarter.
statements.target: Pharma intermediate plant capex plans to be disclosed

statements.quote: In terms of the liquidation timeline for this line [contract assets ~INR 1,065 crore], I think we have said in the past that we expect it to come down towards the end of this financial year.
statements.target: Contract assets of ~INR 1,065 cr expected to decline toward end of FY26

statements.quote: Our trade working capital in terms of days of sales has increased to 139 days… we expect to improve this as market scenario normalizes in the coming quarters.
statements.target: DSO improvement from 139 days as market normalizes
